اقتضبتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَبَتَا (iqtaḍabatā) /iq.ta.dˤa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اُقْتُضِبَتَا (uqtuḍibatā) /uq.tu.dˤi.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
